scripts.concurrent: concurrently -n api,vite -c cyan,magenta "PORT=3000 nodemon --exec tsx server.ts" "vite"
scripts.electron: npm run build && npx electron-rebuild 2>/dev/null || true && electron .
scripts.electron:dev: npx electron-rebuild 2>/dev/null || true && concurrently -n api,vite,electron -c cyan,magenta,yellow "PORT=3000 nodemon --exec tsx server.ts" "vite" "wait-on http://localhost:8000 && ELECTRON_DEV=true electron ."
scripts.electron:build: npm run build && npx electron-rebuild 2>/dev/null || true && electron-builder
scripts.cap:sync: mkdir -p public/assets/databases && cp seed.db public/assets/databases/torah.db && npm run build && rm -rf public/assets && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:ios: mkdir -p public/assets/databases && cp seed.db public/assets/databases/torah.db && npm run build && rm -rf public/assets && npx cap sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.cap:android: mkdir -p public/assets/databases && cp seed.db public/assets/databases/torah.db && npm run build && rm -rf public/assets && npx cap sync && npx cap open android
